review.recipe: Small chilled wine glass, transparent golden amber scotch cocktail, faint haze only, long lemon peel inside, no ice.
review.personality: Keys and closed envelope with repaired worn scarf convey patient homecoming presence. Portrait retains scarf and envelope/key cluster; outer key loops may be cropped on tall phones while legible key shafts survive.
review.world: Old private timber reading room with worn walnut table, one practical lamp, dark neutral falloff, blank handled cream tag; no physical errors.
